name: test-fix-loop-skill
description: test-fix-loop: get a failing test suite green with real fixes, by Rajesh Kasula.

plugins.name: test-fix-loop
plugins.description: Run a project's test suite, fix failures in batches and rerun only what changed, with hard limits on attempts, full runs and time. Any stack: Xcode, SwiftPM, Gradle, Jest/Vitest, pytest, Go, Rust, Playwright.
